name: Extinction Facility
summary:
Extinction Facility is an immersive VR horror fan game that brings a fresh and terrifying twist to the Gorilla Tag-inspired genre. Set in a dark, sprawling facility, the game draws heavily from chilling inspirations like "Big Scary" and "Scary Baboon," creating an atmosphere filled with tension, suspense, and unexpected frights.
